title: How long is a billion seconds?

probes.question: How many years is one billion seconds?

image.alt: Alternative version of image:Wooden hourglass 2.jpg. Wooden hourglass. Total height:25 cm. Wooden disk diameter: 11.5 cm. Running time of the hourglass: 1 hour. Hourglass in other languages: 'timglas'

body.question: How many years is one billion seconds?
body.reveal: About 31.7 years. A million seconds is only about 11.6 days. The gap between 'million' and 'billion' is much bigger than it sounds.
